name: llm-wiki-kit
description: Two skills and five read-only subagents that turn a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode) into a disciplined LLM Wiki maintainer following Karpathy's pattern: wiki (init, research, ingest, capture, archive, lint, index/manifest/log, search, export, publish as a read-only skill, schema) and the lightweight read-only wiki-query.
